description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots signed Joe Michalski.
items.impact: Michalski will compete for a depth role on the offensive line with New England.
items.title: Joe Michalski signs with Patriots

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots signed OL Darrian Dalcourt.
items.impact: Dalcourt will compete for a depth role on the offensive line with New England.
items.title: Darrian Dalcourt signs with Patriots

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots waived Niko Lalos.
items.impact: Lalos will figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Niko Lalos waived by Patriots

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots released RB Terrell Jennings with an injury settlement.
items.impact: Jennings was previously placed on injured reserve by New England.
items.title: Terrell Jennings released with injury settlement

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Titans placed DE Jaylen Harrell on injured reserve.
items.impact: Harrell will likely miss the entirety of the upcoming season.
items.title: Jaylen Harrell placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Titans placed TE Jaren Kanak on injured reserve.
items.impact: Kanak was a seventh-round pick of Tennessee this year out of Oklahoma. He'll miss his rookie season.
items.title: Jaren Kanak placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Titans signed RB Dominic Richardson.
items.impact: Richardson was signed by the Dallas Cowboys as an undrafted free agent after the 2026 NFL Draft. He will compete for a depth role in the Titans running back room.
items.title: Dominic Richardson signs with Titans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Titans signed TE Matt Lauter.
items.impact: Lauter was signed by the Las Vegas Raiders as an undrafted free agent after the 2026 NFL Draft. He'll compete for a depth role in the Titans tight end room.
items.title: Matt Lauter signs with Titans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: DeForest Buckner told reporters he is targeting Week 1 as his return date.
items.impact: Buckner was cleared to practice in late July after undergoing surgery in the offseason. He is slowly working his way back each day of training camp.
items.title: DeForest Buckner targeting Week 1 return

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jalen Pitre returned to practice on Sunday at Texans training camp.
items.impact: Pitre had missed time last week in practice.
items.title: Jalen Pitre returns to practice Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins waived/injured CB Ethan Robinson.
items.impact: Robinson will figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared.
items.title: Ethan Robinson waived by Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins signed LB Cam Riley.
items.impact: Riley spent part of the 2025 season on Tennessee's practice squad. He'll compete for a depth role in the Dolphins linebacker room.
items.title: Cam Riley signs with Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins signed QB Mark Gronowski.
items.impact: Gronkowski will figure to see some action in the preseason with Quinn Ewers dealing with a groin injury.
items.title: Mark Gronowski signs with Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Commanders coach Dan Quinn said Trey Amos remains without a clear timetable to return.
items.impact: Amos suffered a fractured fibula last season which led to him opening up training camp on the PUP list.
items.title: Trey Amos without timetable to return

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Commanders coach Dan Quinn said Nick Allegretti will return to practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Allegretti has been banged up since late July early in training camp. He'll likely be eased back into practices.
items.title: Nick Allegretti to return to practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Commanders coach Dan Quinn said TE John Bates will return to practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Bates is competing for a depth role in the tight end room for Washington.
items.title: John Bates to return to practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens signed RB Jonathan Ward.
items.impact: Ward last appeared in the regular season with the Steelers in 2024. He'll compete for a depth role in the Ravens backfield.
items.title: Jonathan Ward signs with Ravens

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins placed OL Jamaree Salyer on injured reserve.
items.impact: Salyer signed with Miami back in March after he started five games for the Chargers last season. He'll likely miss the upcoming season.
items.title: Jamaree Salyer placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Lions waived CB Loren Strickland with an injury designation.
items.impact: Strickland will figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared. Detroit signed CB Ekow Boye-Doe as the corresponding move.
items.title: Loren Strickland waived by Lions

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Lions waived RB Kye Robichaux with an injury designation.
items.impact: Robichaux will figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared. Detroit signed RB Trayveon Williams as the corresponding move.
items.title: Kye Robichaux waived by Lions

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Lions signed CB Ekow Boye-Doe.
items.impact: Boye-Doe signed with the Chiefs after going undrafted in 2023. He will compete for a depth role in the secondary for Detroit.
items.title: Ekow Boye-Doe signs with Lions

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Lions signed RB Trayveon Williams.
items.impact: Williams played three games for the Chargers and four games for the Browns last season. He will compete for a depth role in the Lions backfield.
items.title: Trayveon Williams signs with Lions

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans signed TE Louis Hansen.
items.impact: Hansen signed with Houston in June and was waived in late July. He returns for a second stint with them.
items.title: Louis Hansen signs with Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Gracen Halton is battling through an ankle injury.
items.impact: Halton also missed practice time earlier in August with a knee injury. He remains day-to-day.
items.title: Gracen Halton has ankle injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers say Dominick Puni is dealing with a concussion.
items.impact: Puni will have to clear all protocols before he is cleared to return to practice. He will likely miss the 49ers next preseason game as a result.
items.title: Dominick Puni placed in concussion protocol

title: Fantasy Player News
